title: Two Bedroom Pied-à-Terre off West End Avenue
description:
The 121 Hotel's accommodations will make you feel immediately at home, thanks to their residential-style design and impeccably selected furnishings. With a contemporary but restrained look, they feel like your Nashville luxury pied-à-terre. The 121 Hotel offers guests the ultimate in flexibility—reserve an individual room or suite, an entire floor with full kitchen, or the entire building for groups and events. Full catering and programming services are available to make your stay unforgettable.

The space
Our 2 bedroom Superior rooms are the lap of luxury, with ample living space, a California King bed, executive desk, 55 ” HDTV, and spacious bathroom with modern finishes. This room also features a second, attached bunk room. Perfect for a weekend retreat with your best friends or a family trip, make yourself feel at home at the 121 Hotel.

Features:
Modern California King Bed
Plush California King Mattress
Comfortable Seating Area
Adjoined Bunk Room
Overdyed area rugs
Undercounter refrigerator
Walk-in, duel head shower/or soaking tub
Ceiling fan
In-room Coffee
Independent air control system

121 provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we’re at your fingertips!

Other things to note
Home Truths:
- This room does not include access to the kitchen unless booked as part of a full floor buyout.
- Please note we have 16 similar units, listing photos vary by unit.
- We allow service animals at this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please note that there are ring cameras that monitor the hotel hallways for guest security. There are no cameras inside the rooms.
- Please note that this is a self-service vacation rental with contactless check-in and no staff on site.

Disclaimers:
- No smoking in or outside of this home. Subject to a $500 fine.
- Occupancy and noise limits are strongly enforced. Subject to fines that can reach up to $10,000 per violation.
- IDs and security deposits when applicable will be requested after booking
- We have the right to report and prosecute all Credit Card Fraud
